changes: Inlined the engine into one import-free middleware file that exports only onRequest.

Reads body.messages only. The protocol adapter that walks Chat, Anthropic, Responses and Gemini bodies is not ported, so a request without a messages array goes on unchanged instead of being rewritten segment by segment.
Dropped replaceImageUrls: which models take images is provider configuration, and its placeholders would only fire for some of them.
Dropped createCompressionStats and the telemetry that goes with it.

The four steps, their order, the word-boundary lookback of 80 characters and the [truncated] suffix are the engine's own. Four places differ on purpose, each because the engine's version drops or rewrites something the request needed:

A repeated system prompt is dropped only when its whole trimmed text is equal. The engine compares the first 200 trimmed characters, so a second system prompt that shares an opening — two rule sets, two agents — is dropped and the model never reads it.

A repeated message is dropped only when every field is equal, tool_calls and name included. The engine compares the content alone, so a second assistant message carrying different tool calls is dropped and the tool result answering it is left with no call, which an OpenAI-compatible upstream refuses with a 400.

All four steps leave the turn being sent alone — every message after the last assistant one. The engine skips that turn in the tool-result cut only, so its whitespace step rewrites a patch line, a Markdown hard line break or a trailing tab in the message about to go out. A history with no assistant message in it has no past the model has read: there this package touches nothing, while the engine treats every message as history to fold, dedupe and cut.
A cut steps back one unit when it lands between a high and a low surrogate. The engine's word-boundary back-off finds no space in emoji or CJK text, so it cuts a surrogate pair in half.
Options are read from ctx.options instead of a module-level configuration: maxToolLength, compressToolResults and preserveSystemPrompt.
